}}'''Wildrose''' is the name of a horse once ridden by [[Min Farshaw]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wildrose}}

==Activities==
Wildrose is the horse that Min rides from [[Tar Valon]] to [[Kore Springs]]{{ref/book|5|1}} and later into [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|5|26}} When a delegation is sent by the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] to [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Caemlyn]], Min goes with them on Wildrose.{{ref/book|6|41}} Wildrose carries Min back and forth between the [[Royal Palace of Andor]], spending time with Rand, and the [[Crown of Roses]], the inn where the Aes Sedai reside.{{ref/book|6|49}}

Wildrose is later mentioned indirectly by Min, when she and Rand enter the attic of the Royal Palace in Caemlyn. Min reminds Rand of how she abandoned her horse for him.{{ref/book|9|11}}
